বর্ষাকালে বাংলাদেশের সবচেয়ে সুন্দর জায়গাগুলোর একটি হয়ে উঠে টাঙ্গুয়ার হাওর। সুন্দর বিশাল সুসজ্জিত হাউসবোটে করে অনেক সাচ্ছন্দ্যে উপভোগ করা যায় হাওরের বিশালতা। আর সাথে নিলাদ্রী লেক, যাদুকাটা নদী, সবুজে ঘেরা মেঘালয়ের পাহাড়, শিমুল বাগান, লাকমাছড়া, এসব অপরূপ সুন্দর জায়গাতো আছেই।

বর্ষাকালে নিলাদ্রী লেক যেন ভূ-স্বর্গে পরিণত হয়। চারপাশে সবুজ ঘাস আর ছোট ছোট টিলা, পাহাড় মিলিয়ে এত বেশি সুন্দর হয়ে উঠে যে এ জায়গাকে বাংলার কাশ্মীর বলে থাকেন অনেকেই। আমরা যখন যাই তখন বিকেলে বৃষ্টি ভেজা নীলাদ্রি লেক দেখে সত্যিই মুগ্ধ হয়ে তাকিয়ে ছিলাম। 

টাঙ্গুয়ার হাওরে প্রিমিয়াম এসি - নন এসি বা যেকোন বাজেটের হাউজবোট বুক করতে কল বা হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ করুন 01817-221548 নম্বরে 👉 অথবা ইনবক্স করুন আমাদের পেইজে -  https://www.facebook.com/TanguarhaorhouseboatbookingbyTC



Tanguar Haor becomes one of the most beautiful places in Bangladesh during monsoons. The vastness of Haor can be enjoyed with great comfort in a beautiful spacious well-equipped houseboat. And along with Niladri Lake, Jadukata Nodi, Meghalaya mountains surrounded by greenery, Shimul Bagan, Lakmachara, there are these wonderful beautiful places.

Niladri lake turns into heaven during monsoon. Surrounded by green grass and small hills, mountains become so beautiful that many people call this place the Kashmir of Bengal. When we visited in the afternoon we were really fascinated by the Niladri lake which was wet with rain.
 
Nestled in the northeastern region of Bangladesh lies a hidden gem of natural wonder - Tanguar Haor. This serene wetland ecosystem, located in the district of Sunamganj, is a biodiverse paradise that beckons adventurous souls to embark on a unique journey of discovery. And what better way to experience the magic of Tanguar Haor than through a tranquil houseboat tour?

Tanguar Haor is not just a geographical marvel; it's a harmonious blend of nature and culture. The pristine wetlands, encompassing an area of over 100 square kilometers, transform into a sprawling mosaic of life during the monsoon season. With its intricate network of waterways, floating meadows, and lush greenery, the haor becomes a sanctuary for countless bird species, aquatic life, and local flora.

Setting foot on a traditional Bangladeshi houseboat at the Tanguar Haor is like stepping into a dream. These houseboats are not just vessels; they are floating abodes of comfort and serenity. As you glide through the calm waters, you're embraced by the symphony of nature – the melodious calls of birds, the gentle rustling of the reeds, and the soothing ripple of water create an ethereal ambiance that's hard to replicate elsewhere.

A typical Tanguar Haor houseboat tour offers a journey that unveils the essence of this captivating ecosystem. Imagine waking up to a breathtaking sunrise, painting the sky with hues of gold and pink, right from the comfort of your cabin. The day unfolds with explorations – a leisurely boat ride guided by local experts who share their wisdom about the haor's ecology and the efforts in place to preserve its delicate balance.
The bird enthusiasts among us will find Tanguar Haor a paradise. 

No journey is complete without experiencing the local flavors. Houseboat tours offer a tantalizing glimpse into the culinary tapestry of the region. From traditional Bangladeshi dishes to local delicacies crafted with freshly caught fish, every meal is a feast that satiates both hunger and curiosity.

Embarking on Your Tanguar Haor Houseboat Tour
When planning your Tanguar Haor houseboat tour, consider reaching out to local tour operators who can guide you through this unforgettable experience. Keep in mind that the best time to visit is during the monsoon season, between May and September, when the haor is at its most vibrant.
